scope: Raw data is not a ready-to-feed neural tensor. This contract applies to the future learner projection.
public_structure: Use candidate IDs and substation IDs only to gather known masked action commands and construct connectivity. Do not concatenate numeric IDs as learned scalar features.
observation_file: Contains original current observation and base-action vectors for audit/reconstruction. The raw observation also includes calendar fields. Do not feed the complete vector directly to a model while claiming calendar identifiers are excluded; an explicit physical-field projection is required.
split_rule: Filter metadata by predeclared date partition before any fitted transformation. All prefixes and random replicas of that calendar group stay together.
status: Data/label separation contract only. No model projection or training is executed in GRID100.
